author: abecker
quote:
No preorders. That was supposed to be a rule. NO PREORDERS.
But people didn't listen, and here we are. With GTA chores and dating sim 2026 running at 30FPS if your console is doing well and you're staring at the ground. 

We won't learn, that's it. These greedy megacorps are going to keep getting away with this because people do not have the self-control to wait and see what the final product looks like! 

Congratulations. This is the GTA you deserve for pre-ordering a digital release as if they're going to run out of codes.
